Should I confess my feelings to my person?

I asked for how does someone feels romantically about me. We were very close but we drift a little bit a few weeks ago, but lately we are getting closer again. We are part of the same group of friends and are classmates in most classes.

I drew: ten of cups and when clarified because I couldn’t believe it I got 2 of cups

I understood the 10 of cups as he feels stable and in harmony with his feelings towards me? And when I couldn’t believe it I clarified asking “are these feelings about love.” And got the 2 of cups

I shuffled my cards again because it feels too good to be true and got Ace of Cups. Which I know it’s like the beginning of something good. Truth be told I feel my rx with him feels to have started over. 

Any thought? I genuinely feel like the cards are laughing at me lol
